senses.gloss:
Daityārikavi
son of Śaṅkara; an. grandson of Pañcānana Kavīśvara. [Page169-b]
--C. on Amarakośa. written in Orissa. Hpr. IV. 18.

Daityāri(paṇḍita)
poet. Padyāvalī 192. 253. Prob. same a. previous.

Daitaviveka
or Dvaitaviṣayaviveka. dh. on doubtful points of smṛti. by Vardhamānopādhyāya, son of Bhaveśa an. chief justice of Mithilā under the Karṇāṭikas. C. 1500 A. D. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 567b.
Mithilā I. 234. 234A. Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p.. 10. 15.
Q. by him in his Daṇḍaviveka. See JASB(NS) XI (1915) p. 401.
--from Pañcadaśī (C.. IV) of Vidyāraṇya. Oudh XX. 230.
See Pañcadaśī.
--dh. by Vibhākara. Mithilā.
